name: stream-response

steps.name: open the stream
steps.note: The endpoint and its credentials come from the configuration Flow, so this model carries no address of its own.

steps.name: read the stream line by line
steps.note: Reader exists only for a response the platform marked as a stream, and then only one line is held at a time however long the answer is. For an ordinary answer Reader is null and the body is already in Content, so the step covers both: which one arrives is decided by the endpoint, not by this Flow.

documentation: Reads a response as it arrives and passes each chunk on.

failure.title: STREAM_FAILED
